playground.outputEmpty: Press “Run Python” to see the output.
playground.passed: The output contains everything expected. Nice work!
playground.keepGoing: Almost — the output still needs to contain:
playground.errorIntro: Python raised an error. Read the traceback bottom-up: the last line says what, the line above it says where.
playground.timeout: Execution took longer than {{seconds}} s and was stopped — most likely an infinite loop. Python will start again on the next run.
playground.loadError: Python could not be loaded. The first run downloads Pyodide from a CDN and needs an internet connection — try again.
playground.note: Python runs entirely in your browser (Pyodide, WebAssembly): it downloads on the first run (~10 MB) and is cached afterwards. Your code never leaves the device. This is a convenience for exercises — it does not replace a local installation.
